# Rambo Walls & Ceilings

> rambowalls.com — Commercial drywall, suspended ceilings and steel stud framing, Vancouver and Lower Mainland BC.

Commercial drywall, suspended ceilings, steel stud framing and tenant improvement contractor serving Vancouver and the Lower Mainland BC. Contact Mason at 778-773-2790.

## Services

- Suspended & T-Bar Ceilings
- Drywall Boarding, Taping & Finishing (Level 1-5)
- Steel Stud Framing
- Tenant Improvements
- Warehouse & Industrial
- Custom Home Renovations
- Fire-Rated Assemblies
